subject: Mental Models
title: Red Queen Effect
description: A short lesson to help you apply Red Queen Effect.

hook.text: In Alice in Wonderland, the Red Queen says you must run as fast as you can just to stay in place.

buildup.text: The Red Queen Effect says in competitive environments.

discovery.text: Leigh Van Valen proposed this in 1973 for evolutionary biology.

twist.text: Businesses face the same pressure. Standing still is falling behind.

climax.text: Build continuous improvement into your system.

punchline.text: Run constantly just to maintain your position.

quiz.question: Who proposed the Red Queen Effect in biology?
